<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 18:7">Targ. O. Lev. XVIII, 7</cite> <cite ref="P00691"><he>עִירְיַת</he></cite> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. a. Y. <cite ref="P00692"><he>עֶרְ׳</he></cite>); a. v. fr.—Y. Meg. IV, 75ᶜ (expl. <he>המכנה בעריות</he>, Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 4:9">Meg. IV, 9</cite>) <he>בעריי׳ דאבוי ובע׳ דאימיה</he> he who modifies the text speaking of the nakedness of one’s father or mother (<cite ref="Leviticus 18:7">Lev. XVIII, 7</cite>, by translating ‘weakness’ or ‘disgrace’; v. Bab.
